description: This file defines a Zustand store for managing user authentication state, including login, registration, session loading, and logout functionalities, using persist middleware for state persistence.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Authenticates user with identifier and password, updates store with user info and token.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers a new user with email, mobile, username, password and stores user info upon success.

methods.name: loadSession
methods.description: Loads current user session from backend if token exists.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Logs out the user and clears authentication data from the store.
